reviews.t: HAUSBELL JUST DIED, but it made my hair feel silky smooth for a few months. SO SAD!
reviews.x: Sept 2020: This arrived yesterday, so I used it this morning. I LOVE IT! My hair looked and felt fabulous and it was so easy to use. Two days ago I tried my friend's $99 version and this model was just as good. It is well made and the components are equal or better than the more expensive model. I'm so glad I gave the HAUSBELL Hair Dryer Brush a chance and saved at least $60. Update, April 10,  2021: It died. I have shorter, curly hair; so I do not use this all of the the time. When I turned it
I love this hairdryer! It dries quickly and leaves my hair smooth and straight. I towel dry first and sometimes use on dry hair with great results.
This is the perfect solution for drying hair quickly with a beautiful sleek finish. Due to physical limitation I’ve never been able to use a roll brush and blow dryer. This is the perfect solution.

Esta bien el cepillo pero le falta potencia tengo el cabello rizado y largo hasta media espalda y dure como el doble de tiempo de otro cepillo que ya había tenido antes pero que ya no me funcionó así que lo regresé y traté el revlon y está mucho mejor. Pero si tiene el cabello corto y no tan rizado si le va funcionar bien.

I wasn't sure if buying a lower cost hair dryer brush would end in regret, but I'm pretty happy so far.  It does get quite hot, so I would recommend a heat protectant serum before using it.  I especially like that it's not circular - it's oblong, so it gives you different options for varied levels of straight / curves.
Works quickly on semi-air-dried hair best, and leaves it smooth & silky.  A hairdresser friend recommended it and I think it's fantastic for the price. Ordered one for my daughter for Christmas!

reviews.t: I can’t say how much I love this!!
reviews.x: Love this tool!! Works so well!! Leaves hair super soft!
Great styling tool. Easy to use and dries hair quickly.

Effective: This is a freaking game changer. My hair sits right on my shoulders in length and I can have it completely dry out of the shower within 20 minutes or less (normally closer to 10). Even better, the highest setting is perfectly powerful and effective but not so hot that it burns my neck if I stay in one place too long. My hair is super healthy and shiny after using this and doesn't feel like its crisping with every second this is on.  Small: I am a tiny person. My hands, as well, are su

I had a revlon dryer but it bit the dust. I read the reviews and a influencer review so I decided to buy it since it was cheaper than the revlon one. It did not compare at all to the revlon one. It does t heat up very much and it doesn't have as many bristles. I will be sending it back and just getting the revlon dryer.

This hair dryer is very good, simple and easy to use, it is not too heavy and has a very modern design I loved the golden color!  Besides that it leaves my hair shiny and I didn't feel that it hit much like the other dryers ... super recommended!

I have long hair with an unruly curl to it. This dryer/ straightener combo is by far the best product I have used. It saves so much time on drying and leaves a nice smooth “just walked out of the salon” finish to it. Highly recommend!

Amazing. It will cut down styling my hair so much. My salon wanted me to buy a much more expensive version at my last appointment and I declined. I found this one and am equally happy with the results!-
Very easy to use and even though I haven’t used one of the more expensive ones I can’t imagine it doing a better job. Cuts my hair drying, styling time in half.

reviews.t: Very easy to use.  Results were amazing even in very humid conditions
reviews.x: Very easy to use.  Results were amazing even in very humid conditions
It’s perfect!! So easy to use and so fast to get my hairstyle!! 😍😍
Love this product!! Great but for the money!!
Doesn't get hot only slightly warm on high.

reviews.t: Nice but it won't replace my regular hair dryer
reviews.x: I got this for Christmas and it does leave my hair soft but it takes forever to dry.  It took over 3x as long to dry my hair using this vs my regular hair dryer. It could be that I still need to get use to it since it did put off a lot of heat.  I also didn't notice much if any volume but I didn't add any product to my hair before drying it.  Since it was a gift I will keep it and use it when we plan on going somewhere but it will not replace my regular hair dryer.

This hair dryer brush is amazing! Using a regular hair dryer & barrel brush would take me about 40-45 minutes to completely dry my hair. I have long, medium thickness hair. With this dryer brush it only takes 15 minutes to dry!!! I am saving so much time now. And my hair looks great! I love the body and waves this gives my hair❤️  Just get it! You won’t regret it!!

reviews.t: Kind of life altering when it comes to blowing out my hair
reviews.x: Game changer. Easy to use. Heat temp settings are great for my fine textured medium density hair (naturally curly). I finally, Finally tried one and highly recommended this one. Nice price point, easy to hold, easy to use, very happy with results. I was on the fence for Years with this type of tool. I’m so glad I finally got one.

I’m writing this review after one use and my hair is two days dirty and of course dry. I opened it up and tried it out and I am impressed it looks like a salon blowout (maybe better😬) from major bed head with no wetting of my hair or anything. Note* my hair is curly and my grays are kind of frizzy.

Got this as a present and was super excited to use it! Had used one my friend had and was expecting for the same results.  This thing does not heat up at all! It’s just really loud! Better off just using a regular hair dryer. Really disappointed! Just pay the extra $10 dollars for the Revlon brand.

Definitely use on damp hair not wet. You will need the right product if you're expecting smooth frizz free hair its not going to happen without the right hair product. Volume is great and definitely leaves that blowout look. Just time consuming as it dowsnt dry very fast.

This is a very nice dryer. It does just what it say. This dryer brushes and straighten at the same time. The drying power blow throu out the Brissels. This shorten the time of doing hair.  Love it.  I gave it 4 star because of the size. It's big. But still love it.

claims.text: Users frequently praise the product for leaving hair smooth, silky, and shiny.
Many reviewers say it dries hair quickly and saves significant styling time.
Reviewers commonly describe the tool as easy to use.
Several customers feel it performs as well as or better than more expensive alternatives for the price.
Some reviewers report weak heating or insufficient power, especially for long or curly hair.
